content.text:
The site matches the approved screenshots again. `npx playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts` now passes at both desktop and phone size. There were three bugs, all in `site/css/styles.css`:

1. **Hidden messages were showing.** `.d-none` was set to `display: block`, so the "Form submission successful!" and "Error sending message!" notices appeared in the contact form. It is now `display: none`.
2. **Team photos were squashed.** `.team-member img` had `width: 7rem` instead of `14rem`, so the photos were distorted. I set the width back to `14rem`.
3. **Portfolio captions were too light.** `.portfolio-caption-heading` had `font-weight: 400` instead of `700`. I set it back to `700`.

I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
